## FIDELITY (GATE)
**High-fidelity assessment: PASS** — The design has a full color palette (purple primary #7c3aed, pink accent #ec4899, amber #f59e0b), multiple shadows (5 shapes), one gradient on the hero background, and zero placeholder text. This is not a wireframe.

## DETAILED REVIEW

### Visual Hierarchy
The headline at 48px dominates appropriately, but the floating cards on the right create visual competition. The cards are large, white, and elevated with strong shadows — they pull attention away from the CTA buttons. The Card1Header purple square (#7c3aed) directly competes with the primary brand color, creating confusion about what's interactive.

### Alignment & Spacing
- **Incons
- [high] Fix headline text overflow to display complete 'Design at the speed of thought' with responsive wrapping or container expansion
- [high] Add 'Get Started' text label to primary button and standardize both button styles with proper padding and visual hierarchy
- [high] Replace abstract floating cards with actual product screenshot or realistic UI mock showing PixelForge interface
- [med] Establish proper vertical rhythm: add 80-120px top padding below navbar, align all left edges, add 120px bottom padding before white section
- [med] Refine color system: add subtle radial gradient to hero background, unify accent colors, add shadows to cards for depth separation
- [high] Fix truncated headline 'Design at the speed of thought' by increasing container width or reducing font size to ensure full visibility
- [high] Replace empty placeholder cards with actual product screenshot or high-fidelity UI mockup showing real interface elements
- [high] Establish consistent 1280px max-width container with 80px horizontal padding aligning navbar and hero content left edges
- [med] Add depth to purple background with radial gradient and layered shadows to white cards (0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1))
- [med] Standardize button styling: primary with gradient #111827-#1F2937 and hover lift, secondary with white/10% background, both at 8px radius with 24px gap
